title: The Fairness of Risk Scores Beyond Classification: Bipartite Ranking and the xAUC Metric
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and statistical metrics (xAUC) for predictive risk scores in traditional machine learning (e.g., recidivism and credit scoring). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems in the sense of investigating religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral reasoning frameworks.
